title: MCP servers for web work
status: AUTHORED. The callable plane. Small on purpose: a server is listed only with a working config.

atom_notes.A16: a tool description is text the model obeys, so every server is an instruction channel
atom_notes.A11: an MCP server is a dependency, and registries are unaudited
atom_notes.A02: the server holds credentials and acts with them, so its scope is a trust boundary

required_cells.why: inventory what the agent can call before trusting any of it
scan descriptions and configs, not only inputs
ship configs, not links, or the repository rots like the ones it replaces
prove a server does what it claims before it holds a credential
pin and verify tool descriptions across versions

entries.role: Working configs plus the rule that a server ships only with a config, and unverified ones are excluded from generated configs
entries.note: Local directory. The rule matters: MCP catalogs are where link rot and prompt injection enter.

entries.name: This repo: skills/web-arsenal/
entries.role: The order of operations as a loadable skill

tree.q: Are you wiring a server, or reviewing one?
tree.why: Wiring is an install problem. Reviewing is a supply chain problem, and the second is the one nobody does.

branches.action: use a config that is known to start. never add a server by name and link alone
read every tool description as if it were a prompt, because it is. then scan for injection and pin the hashes
registry size is a supply chain risk, not a feature. pick the smallest server that does the job
branches.oracle: server passes the scan and the pin check

branches.a: Testing an agent that uses servers
branches.action: inject through tool output and measure both attack success and utility loss

mirror.control: pin and review descriptions as code

mirror.detect: server requesting scopes beyond its stated purpose
new or changed server in config
instructions in tool output followed by a call

gaps.gap: No MCP registry that pins descriptions by hash
gaps.build_candidate: a manifest per server with name, description and schema hashes, checked at startup

gaps.gap: No way to review a server's actual behaviour without running it
gaps.build_candidate: a dry run mode that lists tool calls without executing, plus a declared scope per tool
conformance check per server plus the pin manifest above
